text_block_list.text:
There's no mistaking Голд Шип's
boisterous
laugh, and I can't help but
check on her.
text_block_list.name: Монолог

text_block_list.text: Hey, Trainer! Look at the ground!
text_block_list.name: Голд Шип

text_block_list.text:
There's a paper airplane at my feet, so I
pick it up
and unfold it.
text_block_list.name: Монолог

text_block_list.text:
A series of lines crisscross over the
paper, and
scrawled in the middle are
the words "Go, go,
Golshi!"
text_block_list.name: Монолог

text_block_list.text: That's gotta be fan mail, right?!
text_block_list.name: Голд Шип

text_block_list.text:
I can't believe it! I just folded it up along
the
lines, and this puppy took off like a
jet!
text_block_list.name: Голд Шип

text_block_list.text:
Whoever sent the fan letter sure knows
Голд Шип
well. I guess they're not a fan
for nothing!
text_block_list.name: Монолог

text_block_list.text:
The fan's thoughtfulness and love for
Голд Шип
renews my own motivation as
a trainer.
text_block_list.name: Монолог

text_block_list.text:
Is that a twinkle I see in your eyes? You
raring to
go? Well, I'm right there with
ya!
text_block_list.name: Голд Шип

text_block_list.text:
Hang on, I'll fold us a paper airplane big
enough
to ride, and we can hop on and
make straight for
the clouds!
text_block_list.name: Голд Шип
